msItem.title: Tigre poems (fidal)
msItem.note: Tigre poems, written in Ethiopian characters and with titles in Italian. The text is written on the left column. The columns on the right side of the page, which have been probably intended for a translation, are blank. Most of the authors of the poems are the same as in Publications of the Princeton Expedition to Abyssinia. Lieder der Tigrē Stämme: Tigrē TextEnnoLittmannLeydenBrill1913IIIbm:Littmann1913Tigrebm:Littmann1913Tigre. Apart from the variation in orthography and redaction, the larger part of the poems can be found in Publications of the Princeton Expedition to Abyssinia. Lieder der Tigrē Stämme: Tigrē TextEnnoLittmannLeydenBrill1913IIIbm:Littmann1913Tigrebm:Littmann1913Tigre. The titles follow, as far as can be determined, the transcription by Littmann.
